The survey maṇṇu/manḍul-type sand responses preserve the source sand gloss as a broader use of soil/earth; maṇal/maṛuḷu-type responses match the explicit sand formation. No source gloss is silently changed. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
